svg.title: ATLAS device: all 30 ESP32 pins
svg.desc: Pinout of the ESP32 DevKit V1 used by ATLAS: every header pin with its name, GPIO number, type, and what ATLAS wires to it. Twelve pins are in use and eighteen are free; the GNSS receiver on UART2 is simulated.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What every pin can do, and what ATLAS wires to it
